item.description:
Bouncebin 1.1.0

  • 3D — a third tab beside Album and List. Your playlist becomes an object you can pick up: drag to turn it over, scroll to zoom.
  • LP sleeve or CD case. The sleeve is a 12-inch jacket with the running order printed on the back and the playlist name down both spines. The CD is a real jewel case, hinge and disc and all.
  • Choose back… sits beside the cover button, so a playlist can have back-cover artwork of its own. Without one, the back prints the running order instead.
  • Put it on the table. The camera turns to a wooden table and the album drops in and lands.
  • Wrap it seals it in shrink wrap, creases and all. Press again to take it off.
  • Covers that are not square are now trimmed to fit rather than squashed, everywhere they appear.

The 3D view loads what it needs the first time you open it, so nothing here slows down starting the app.
